scope: Explicit cell links for current Chapter9/10 and appendix table census. No inference of complete table coverage from fold agreement.
arithmetic_source: Existing replay scalar/native-array outputs; cached event category labels for exact partitions. q-refinement follows the archived secondary_common_space.py formula with training-only half-count smoothing.
fixed_input_metadata_scope: Selected sigma and coarse-grid kernel cells read pinned cache metadata; this checks the coordinates used in actual replay, not a new optimizer or selector run.

q_refinement.formula: q_c=(N_train_cell+0.5)/(N_train_zone+1.5); reference event log intensity=W_log_intensity+log(q_c); reference cell exposure=q_c*W_zone_exposure
q_refinement.alignment: Exact cached event time/excess/order and cell-to-zone labels checked before refinement.
